candidates.label: A
candidates.notes: Multiple serious misreads: ニンジャライス for ニンジンライス (with invented gloss 'ninja rice'), 励まず（はげまず）'does not encourage' for 励ます（はげます）, 魅める（なぐめる）'charm' for 慰める（なぐさめる）, レジピ for レシピ, ごうした for こうした (gloss left as '[?]'). Also used 【地名】 instead of 〔地名〕. Wrong glosses cascade from the misreadings.

candidates.label: B
candidates.notes: All Japanese text, readings, and index numbers match the image, including 慰める（なぐさめる）, ニンジンライス, こうした, and the 〔人名〕/〔地名〕 brackets. Preserves the indent before ＊腕をふるう as in the image. Supplied English glosses are all accurate dictionary translations.

candidates.label: C
candidates.notes: All Japanese text and readings correct; brackets 〔人名〕/〔地名〕 preserved. Uses 〜 (wave dash variant) instead of ～ — trivial. Does not reproduce the extra indentation on ＊腕をふるう. Glosses are accurate; '(personal name)/(place name)' parentheticals are reasonable renderings.

rationale: B and C are both near-perfect transcriptions with accurate kanji, kana, furigana, indices, and appropriate English glosses. B edges out C by preserving the indentation of the sub-entry ＊腕をふるう and using the exact ～ character. A contains at least five substantive character errors (ニンジャライス, 励まず, 魅める/なぐめる, レジピ, ごうした), several of which propagated into incorrect or missing glosses ('ninja rice', 'does not encourage', 'charm', '[?]'), significantly hurting both accuracy and hallucination control, so it ranks last.
